title: 25% off Select Film & TV Show Boxsets + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: 25% off Select Film & TV Show Boxsets + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi

[Goldberg] For those seeking out 4k titles, ensure you cross-check pricing at EzyDvd before committing to JB. My recent orders have arrived within 3 business days and free shipping over $80.
https://www.ezydvd.com.au/home/30-OFF-UHD-4K-SALE/list/4210/…
https://www.ezydvd.com.au/blu-ray/A-Nightmare-on-Elm-Street-…
https://www.ezydvd.com.au/blu-ray/James-Bond-Sean-Connery-Co…
[Gimmieforfree] And also note that JB wont price match EzyDVD so better off with EzyDVD
[Donkeytong] Re: price match
Maybe it depends who you get? I got a price match from JB for ezydvd just the other week on 4 uhds
[Gimmieforfree] Really? I tried in store and the guy said he wouldn't as it was coming up as overseas and then when I tried with the JB chat they said no bc EzyDVD is not registered for GST
Doesnt make sense since my orders from Ezy comes from Qld and I've always paid GST to them
[rekkore] BTTF 4k anniversary is still cheaper on EZYDVD for anyone who had better trigger discipline than me.
[Goldberg] I still have BTTF and Indiana Jones 4Ks sitting in my cart 😅 Ive spent WAY too much recently though and need to slow down!
[rekkore] Justified it since a box set is the easiest way to get to $80+ for free shipping. I could easily hit it again for another round of Blurays but that's besides the point.
I'll get FOMO in a few years when print media is dead
[S Baldrick] USA region though, so the Special Features on the Blu-ray won't be playable on Australian players
[Gimmieforfree] Says USA as country of origin but not necessarily region as well
I've ordered multiple UHD blu rays from Ezy and even if it said the country of origin was outside Aus (eg US) never had an issue bc it was from the Australian distributor so Aus region
[brotherfranciz] I'm surprised how uncompetitive Amazon is. Usually my go-to when comparing prices.
I've been kinda panic buying 4K in the past month or two (thanks to the Sony announcement) after refusing to double-dip my bluray collection for years.
I make sure to check disc reviews on https://www.blu-ray.com/ and also check whether it is native or upscaled 4K.
[Goldberg] I thought it was just me madly building my library the last few weeks 🤪
[mahd-mahn] Amazon don’t have Australian stock of discs anymore. We usually get them from UK or US less often. They are almost all imported now. I remember buy alita battle angel off Amazon for $13 shipped.
[QuickToThePointless] what announcement was that please? dont keep up with such stuff these days….cheers
[Goldberg] https://au.pcmag.com/sony-playstation-games/119088/sony-hear…
[QuickToThePointless] @Goldberg: thanks - saw the ps5/6 issues….but BD movies?
[vinnycol] Amazon have John Wick 1-4 box set 4k for $76.75 less 11% if you buy another eligible title if anyone's interested…
https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0BZJ6L5B5?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_f…
